assertion.text: Erdős Problem #306: declared status 'open'. Formalized: yes. Let $a/b\in \mathbb{Q}_{>0}$ with $b$ squarefree. Are there integers $1<n_1<\cdots<n_k$, each the product of two distinct primes, such that\[\frac{a}{b}=\frac{1}{n_1}+\cdots+\frac{1}{n_k}?\] Prize: no. Tags: number theory, unit fractions.
